description: Fetches a user's busy time intervals (internal and external calendar events) in ascending order for a period up to 7 days; keyset pagination is not supported.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for fetching a user's busy time intervals from Calendly.

end_time.description: The end of the time range for which to fetch busy times, in RFC3339 format (e.g., '2023-10-26T11:00:00Z'). Must be after start_time.
end_time.title: End Time

start_time.description: The start of the time range for which to fetch busy times, in RFC3339 format (e.g., '2023-10-26T10:00:00Z').
start_time.title: Start Time

user.description: The URI of the user whose busy times are being queried. This is typically the user's Calendly API URI.
user.title: User

inputSchema.title: ListUserBusyTimesRequest

name: list_user_busy_times

BusyTimeSlot.description: Represents a single busy time slot for a user.

buffered_end_time.description: Extended end time that includes buffer time after the event in UTC ISO-8601 format. Present for Calendly events with configured buffer times.
buffered_end_time.title: Buffered End Time

buffered_start_time.description: Extended start time that includes buffer time before the event in UTC ISO-8601 format. Present for Calendly events with configured buffer times.
buffered_start_time.title: Buffered Start Time

end_time.description: End time of the busy period in UTC ISO-8601 format.
end_time.title: End Time

start_time.description: Start time of the busy period in UTC ISO-8601 format.
start_time.title: Start Time

type.description: Type or source of the busy time slot. Possible values include 'calendly' for Calendly scheduled events and 'external' for events from connected external calendars.
type.title: Type

BusyTimeSlot.title: BusyTimeSlot

ListUserBusyTimesResponse.description: Response schema for `ListUserBusyTimes`, containing the user's busy intervals.

collection.description: List of busy time slots for the given user and date range.
collection.title: Collection

pagination.description: Pagination information for the collection response.
pagination.title: Pagination

ListUserBusyTimesResponse.title: ListUserBusyTimesResponse

Pagination.description: Pagination information for the collection response.

count.description: Number of items in the current page.
count.title: Count

next_page.description: URL to fetch the next page of results. Null if there are no more pages.
next_page.title: Next Page

next_page_token.description: Token used for cursor-based pagination to fetch the next page.
next_page_token.title: Next Page Token

previous_page.description: URL to fetch the previous page of results. Null if this is the first page.
previous_page.title: Previous Page

previous_page_token.description: Token used for cursor-based pagination to fetch the previous page.
previous_page_token.title: Previous Page Token

Pagination.title: Pagination
